items:
30A Escapes presents… “21 Hamilton Lane”, a stunning family-friendly retreat in the heart of Rosemary Beach. Just a 4-minute stroll to the Cabana Pool and North Barrett Square, this home offers an outstandingly equipped kitchen, serene views of West Kingston Park, 2 Primary Suites with balconies, 6 beach cruisers, cozy fireplace and a private courtyard. Perfect for up to 10 guests seeking a luxurious beach getaway! Learn more below… 👇

★☆ HIGHLIGHTS ☆★

✔ Two Primary Suites – Both include private balconies and en suites
✔ Cozy Fireplace – Perfect for relaxing evenings
✔ Fully-Stocked Chef's Kitchen – Incredible setup for cooking and entertaining
✔ 4-Minute Walk to the Cabana Pool – A tropical oasis for the family
✔ Location near North Barrett Square – Boutique shopping and dining 5 minutes away
✔ Serene Park Views – Relax on your front porch overlooking West Kingston Park
✔ Bikes Included – Explore 30A with 6 provided beach cruisers
✔ Driveway Parking for 2 Vehicles
✔ Short Bike Ride to the Beach

Eager to Read More?
Here Are A Few Kind Words from Our Guests:

⭐ "The home is gorgeous with everything you need. Beds were so comfy, and the location is perfect–we’ll be back!" – Kerry S.
⭐ "Loved the neighborhood feel and walking distance to restaurants, pools, and shops. A dreamy getaway!" – Aimee G.
⭐ "The kitchen is a gem! Fully stocked with high-quality utensils and cookware, which made meals a breeze!" – Chris O.

★☆ LIVING AREA ☆★

Step into an inviting open floor plan where elegant decor combines with practical design. The living room features cozy seating, a fireplace with a mounted TV, and direct access to two outdoor spaces – a serene front porch with park views and a courtyard dining area perfect for al fresco meals.

✔ Fireplace-centered living room with TV
✔ Front porch with couch seating facing West Kingston Park
✔ Grill in the courtyard with dining table for 4

★☆ KITCHEN AND DINING ☆★

The kitchen is a chef's dream! Enjoy top-quality cookware, bar seating for casual meals, and a beautiful dining table that can seat six. Whether you're brewing coffee in the morning or hosting dinner at night, this space has you covered.

✔ Fully stocked kitchen with premium All-Clad cookware
✔ Barstool seating for 4 and dining table seating for 6
✔ Additional back patio with private courtyard

★☆ OUTDOOR PRIVATE OASIS ☆★

Find tranquility and fun right outside. Step out from the living room to the front porch facing West Kingston Park and enjoy your morning coffee on the cozy couch. From the other living room door, access a dining table for four and a grill, perfect for outdoor meals. The private courtyard also provides extra seating for evening drinks or quiet moments. And for leisurely rides through Rosemary Beach and beyond, take advantage of the 6 included beach cruisers.

✔ Private courtyard with ample seating
✔ Front porch with park views and cozy seating
✔ Outdoor dining table for four and a grill
✔ 6 beach cruisers to explore 30A

★☆ BEDROOMS AND BATHROOMS ☆★

1st Floor:
✔ Powder Room – Full laundry area and conveniently located half-bath

2nd Floor:
✔ Primary Suite 1 – King bed, en suite, private balcony with park views
✔ Primary Suite 2 – King bed, en suite, private balcony facing courtyard
✔ Kids Bunk Room – Two twin-over-twin bunk beds, shared hallway bathroom

3rd Floor Loft:
✔ Twin Bedroom – Two custom-built twin beds with cozy charm

★☆ ROSEMARY BEACH COMMUNITY ☆★

Immerse yourself in the charm and luxury of the Rosemary Beach community, a stunning beachside destination known for its award-winning architecture and idyllic ambiance. Whether you're seeking adventure, relaxation, or romance, this vibrant locale offers something for everyone.

✔ Rosemary Beach Community: Beachside destination with award-winning architecture
✔ Racquet Club – one of the world’s top 75 tennis spots
✔ Multiple parks and greens with playgrounds, a splash pad, butterfly park, and hidden boardwalks with fountains
✔ Fitness Center with massage and yoga

4 RESORT POOLS:
✔ Barbados Pool: Gulf-side, French West Indies style with a fountain
✔ Coquina Pool: Gulf-side, with a relaxing negative edge overflow
✔ Sky Pool: Park-side, indoor, heated year-round with radiant heated decking in winter
✔ Cabana Pool: Park-side, cabana-style with a children’s pool and playground nearby

★☆ LOCATION ☆★

Perfectly situated in the heart of Rosemary Beach, 21 Hamilton Lane offers unparalleled access to local attractions and world-class beaches.

✔ 4-Min Walk to Cabana Pool
✔ 5-Min Walk to North Barrett Square with Boutique Shops and Restaurants
✔ Short Stroll or swift bike ride to Emerald Waters and Sugar-White Sands

★☆ OTHER THINGS TO KNOW ☆★

✔ To ensure a smooth and secure stay, guests are required to complete the 30A Escapes Rental Agreement after booking. This agreement outlines important house rules and helps us provide the best experience possible. Once your reservation is confirmed, you will receive a link via the booking platform to sign the agreement. After it is completed, we will send your official booking confirmation email with all the details you need. If you have any questions, feel free to reach out to us directly – we are always happy to help!
✔ Travel insurance is NOT included in your quote. It can be purchased upon booking, added to your reservation by the final payment date, or obtained independently.
✔ We do NOT accept wire transfers for payment. (AMEX, Visa, and MasterCard ONLY)
✔ This property has 6 bikes for guest use. To utilize the bikes, a waiver must be signed before the code is provided to the guest. Additional bikes can be rented through 30A Escapes.
✔ LSVs are not allowed in Rosemary Beach, Seacrest, or Alys Beach.
✔ There is currently active construction next door to this property, and we do not have a completion date at this time.
✔ The outdoor fireplace is not for guest use at this time.
✔ To see a virtual tour of this home, please visit https://www.insidemaps.com/app/walkthrough-v2/?projectId=Gtn2e9Gay7&env=production

☆★ YOUR STAY - OUR PRIORITY ☆★

At 30A Escapes, we are committed to providing a luxurious, safe, and stress-free vacation experience. Enjoy 24/7 support and an immaculate home designed for comfort and relaxation.

★☆ BOOK TODAY AND START YOUR 30A ESCAPE! ☆★
